question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` define wrapping for every option set larger than four, or should the two-row behavior remain specific to Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both implementations can solve the reported truncation, but source inspection does not establish an existing shared-component contract for the four-item threshold; choosing that permanent Android design-system policy requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt shared wrapping
options.body: Keep the reusable component behavior because it preserves all sets of four or fewer and provides deterministic readability for every larger set.

options.title: Scope to Skill Workshop
options.body: Retain the existing shared single-row contract and introduce the balanced two-row presentation only around the five-filter Skill Workshop surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Keep the reusable component behavior because it preserves all sets of four or fewer and provides deterministic readability for every larger set.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies @obviyus as the Android app owner, and the unresolved choice governs a shared Android design-system component.
